rationale: Reviewed the full diff of main...HEAD (7 files, +263/-43). Two independent changes. (1) Analytics user filters: AnalyticsQueryPipeline._build_query and _build_query_without_time_filter become async and expand every requested user identifier through user_repository.afind_users_by_identifiers into its id, username and email, so a UUID filter also matches codemie_metrics_logs documents keyed by username or email; unresolved identifiers pass through unchanged. Every caller in src/ (query_pipeline.py, handlers/cli/insights_handler.py) now awaits the call; a grep for unawaited call sites returns none. Expansion runs before SecureQueryBuilder's access scoping, which still applies, so it cannot widen what a caller may see. (2) MCP structuredContent: MCPToolInvocationResponse gains an optional structuredContent field; it is serialized to JSON and passed to the LLM and the token limiter only when content holds no text item, so servers that already return text are unaffected. Non-blocking note: on the CLI insights page each widget builds its own query, so a request with a user filter now does one Postgres lookup per widget; the lookup is a bounded IN query and acceptable, caching can be a follow-up if it shows in latency.

business_review.item: Filtering analytics by a user UUID also returns metrics stored under that user's username or email
business_review.notes: _expand_user_filters (query_pipeline.py:792) adds id, username and email of each resolved record; covered by test_expand_user_filters_resolves_uuid_to_all_identifier_forms and test_expand_user_filters_mixed_input_list.

business_review.item: An identifier that does not resolve to a known user still filters as typed
MCP tools that return data only in structuredContent (e.g. Airtable) deliver that data to the LLM
business_review.notes: structured_content_text() used by _limit_output_content, _post_process_output_content and _convert_mcp_response_to_tool_message; test_toolkit_structured_content.py covers parsing, default None, LLM output, text precedence and token limiting.

standards_review.notes: The original commit afcb16111 has no ticket prefix; the squash commit and the MR title use 'EPMCDME-16532: ...' per .ai-run/guides/standards/git-workflow.md (squash merge is the default).

License headers on the two new test files; no line over the 120-character ruff limit. The autouse conftest fixture patches the pipeline module's user_repository name, so other analytics tests do not hit Postgres and other consumers of the singleton are unaffected.

No auth change: SecureQueryBuilder access filtering is applied unchanged after expansion. User identifiers go to the repository as bound parameters. structuredContent is tool output already returned to the same caller.
